claims.title: Reciprocal three-load target-power metrology and all-input reconstruction

quoted_fields.interface: Supply reciprocity in power-normalized ports,a same-feed receiver,three actually calibrated target loads,a bounded isolated local reference and actual stability/error enclosures. Whole-Gram control additionally needs one fixed calibrated linear command map. Twelve raw powers per scalar query;not complete returned-power collection.
quoted_fields.failure: Uncalibrated load scale and load-dependent reference phase have exact counterexamples. One known nonzero load is insufficient in general. The stronger interference information does not refute the older intensity-only square-root theorem or prove photon superiority. Per-configuration front-end metrology does not imply a fixed Gram under arbitrary changing reflections.
